issue.title: Hide empty Translation Notes and Questions sections in the Resources tab [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios A.6, E.14)

## Summary
Online, the Resources tab always shows the Translation Notes and Translation Questions accordions, even when the verse has none, and the tab-wide empty state from #188 never appears. `getVisibleResourceSections` returns all three sections online (`src/utils/resourcesSectionInventory.ts:84-86`); `ResourcesTab` hides only Images & Maps when it loads empty (`src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx:175-188`). The only empty copy is the offline one (`RESOURCES_EMPTY_MESSAGE`, `src/constants/messages.ts:24-25`).

## Expected
- A section with no content for the unit is hidden (#189, #190, #191).
- When the unit has no resources of any kind, the tab shows a centered "No resources available for this verse" (#188).

## Actual
- A.6: Psalms 10:1 shows Translation Notes, which expands to an empty body (Images & Maps is correctly hidden).
- A.6: Mark 1 Translation Questions shows a spinner on expand, then an empty body. TQ loads only when its section is expanded (`useTranslationQuestionsForUnit` runs inside the accordion body, which renders only when expanded), so the tab cannot know it is empty and it refetches on every expand.
- E.14: after Retry online, an empty TQ still expands to a blank body.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Online, open a chapter and go to a verse missing one resource type (e.g. Psalms 10:1 has no Translation Notes content).
2. Open the Resources tab and expand each section.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] TQ loads with the tab (like TN and Images), not on expand.
- [ ] TN and TQ are hidden once they load empty, like Images & Maps.
- [ ] When all sections load empty online, show the centered "No resources available for this verse".
- [ ] Offline copy stays for the no-inventory case; loading and connectivity-unresolved states do not show an empty message.
- [ ] Unit tests cover hide-when-empty per section and the online tab-wide empty state.
- [ ] Android device QA: verse with content, verse with one missing type, verse with none.

## Related
- Spec: #188, #189, #190, #191
- PR #387 (online without inventory gating)
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #592 (offline empty message flashes while loading)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)
